svg.aria-label: Usage Quota for Claude Code: a live band showing 5 Hour and Weekly limits, a forecast to the reset, and context window usage
svg.text: Know your Claude limits before they hit you.
At this pace you’ll run out before Sunday’s reset.
On pace for about 55% by reset – resets in 4h 50m
On pace for about 96% by reset – resets in 3h 05m
Limit will hit in 35m – resets in 1h 50m
On pace for about 80% by reset – resets in 5d 11h
Limit will hit in 4d 2h – resets in 5d 10h
Limit will hit in 3d 3h – resets in 5d 9h

g.text: 5 Hour limit reset: your full allowance is back.
